title: OpenAI focuses on robot brains for humanoid project
excerpt: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman discusses the development of a humanoid robot, noting that the primary difficulty lies in creating the robot's brain.
body_html:
OpenAI is working on the development of a humanoid robot designed to function within environments built for humans. According to OpenAI CEO Sam Altman, building the physical body of the robot is not the primary hurdle of the project.

Instead, Altman highlighted that developing an advanced robot 'brain' is a significantly greater challenge. The effort focuses on enabling the machine to operate effectively in a human-centric world, though specific timelines or technical details about the brain's architecture were not detailed.
